objective: Freeze the low, medium and pressure offered-load candidates on the canonical M-Lab multi-OD burst profile through one formally authorized six-cell consistency matrix.
context: This is a load-contract and analysis-chain validation step, not an algorithm comparison.
Each load tier has two identical non-learning cells with the same trace seed and resolved demand override; the paired difference must be zero if the formal chain is deterministic.
The three tiers are 50, 100 and 200 Mbps; the result selects candidates for later baseline pilot and congestion diagnosis, but does not by itself establish final thresholds or paper effects.
deliverables: A compiled and independently reviewed six-cell matrix
Receipt-verified VM outputs for all three load pairs
A persisted V2 paired analysis and load-tier evidence note
cannot_claim: Q0 optimality or a paper-ready statistical conclusion
acceptance: Matrix identity, exact demand intervention path and pair membership pass independent cold review.
All six cells complete naturally on one clean deployed SHA with conservation and acceptance true.
V2 analysis recomputes delivery_rate for all three paired differences and persists a VERIFIED analysis.
The resulting load table records offered packets, fates, wall time and raw metric validation for each tier.
